name: 28475-manyimage-qwen3vl30ba3b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-FP8 -- public, ungated, image-text-to-text, ~32 GB of fp8 safetensors.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: multimodal sparse-MoE decoder, Qwen3VLMoeForConditionalGeneration, fp8 e4m3 weights with bf16 text dtype; the rest is in the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=32, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1000 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: eight-picture chat: eight distinct 256x256 gradient JPEGs at quality 85 (seeds 42-49) plus a ~32-token question per request, 8 tokens generated, greedy. Nine guidellm datasets zipped row-wise: one `synthetic_text` and eight `synthetic_image`, each with `images_per_request: 1`.
purpose: A multi-image visual chat assistant answering brief questions about eight thumbnails per request, 32 concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit 637f292196237982558936166540ed8d153a75eb (v0.11.1rc6-214-g637f292196).
# The interpreter that runs it and the hardware seal are in configs/env.yaml.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 10000
max-num-seqs: 64

# Must match scenario.json, which puts EIGHT images in every request: it is both the admission
# limit and what the engine's startup profiling pass is sized against. Change one, change both.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 8, "video": 0}

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
mm-processor-cache-gb: 0
